title: Psalms Bible Quiz - Chapter 124
description: Ten questions on Psalms 124: if Yahweh had not been on our side - the waters, the teeth of enemies and the escape like a bird from the fowler's snare.

questions.text: In verse 1, who is called to say, "If it had not been Yahweh who was on our side"?
questions.explanation: Psalms 124:1 says "If it had not been Yahweh who was on our side, let Israel now say."

questions.text: When would they have been lost without Yahweh on their side, according to verse 2?
questions.explanation: Psalms 124:2 says "when men rose up against us."

answers.text: When the earth shook beneath us
When men rose up against us
When famine came on the land
When the kings made a treaty

questions.text: What would "they" have done to us, according to verse 3?
questions.explanation: Psalms 124:3 says "then they would have swallowed us up alive."

questions.text: What would the waters have done, according to verse 4?
questions.explanation: Psalms 124:4 says "then the waters would have overwhelmed us."

questions.text: Which word describes the waters in verse 5?
questions.explanation: Psalms 124:5 says "then the proud waters would have gone over our soul."

questions.text: To what has Yahweh not given us as a prey?
questions.explanation: Psalms 124:6 says "Blessed be Yahweh, who has not given us as a prey to their teeth."

questions.text: What has our soul escaped like, according to verse 7?
questions.explanation: Psalms 124:7 says "Our soul has escaped like a bird out of the fowler's snare."

answers.text: A bird out of the fowler's snare
A lamb from the mouth of the lion

questions.text: What has happened to the snare in verse 7?
questions.explanation: Psalms 124:7 says "The snare is broken, and we have escaped."

questions.text: Where is our help, according to verse 8?
questions.explanation: Psalms 124:8 says "Our help is in Yahweh's name."

questions.text: What does verse 8 say Yahweh made?
questions.explanation: Psalms 124:8 speaks of Yahweh's name, "who made heaven and earth."
